data.caption: theaudioexperts.com.au
data.copy:
It’s here. Meet KEF LUXE.

LUXE brings sculptural design and serious KEF sound together in one beautifully resolved wireless system. It has the kind of presence that catches your eye before the music starts — then gives you the clarity, detail and scale that make you stay for another track.

Our pair is now live and playing in the TAE showroom. We’re launching eight Saturdays of open listening sessions, starting this Saturday from 10am to 4pm.

Bring a track you know inside out. We’ll put it on, turn it up and let LUXE do the talking.

Which song would you play first?

The Audio Experts | Level 1, 1277 Nepean Highway, Cheltenham

#KEF #KEFLUXE #TheAudioExperts #ListenAndBelieve #MelbourneHiFi
data.description: KEF LUXE combines a 165mm Uni-Q driver with MAT, VECO feedback, current-drive amplification, Music Integrity Engine processing and a Ross Lovegrove BMC cabinet.
